The central focus of the image is a close-up of an astronaut in a red spacesuit, floating inside a spacecraft. The astronaut's hand is raised, as if reaching out or gesturing towards something unseen. The background features a pattern of black and white squares, reminiscent of the monoliths from the movie, which are iconic symbols of the film.
